race.comment: SUIT OF WANDS (7) opened up a huge lead before the corner and just kept going last start, destroying a BM80 field over 2541m to avenge a close second the run prior. Not a prolific winner and he does come back in trip today but the dominance of that performance cannot be ignored. INEVITABLE AWARD (5) has had two runs following an 18-month break from racing. Settled midfield and couldn't improve last time out over 2000m at Caulfield. Fitter now and drops 2kgs. No surprise if he suddenly found some form. FIORA BLUE (11) might have been a run short when a tiring sixth over 2014m last Saturday. Expect her to tighten right up now and produce something like her best. ARUGAMAMA (3) passed half the field in the straight but was left in SUIT OF WANDS' wake three weeks ago. Veteran mare who looks to be back in form and is a strong top three hope. DARKNCONFIDENTIAL (2) never performs well at the start of his preps so the duck eggs are not alarming. Can do better fourth-up.
